slot_scores.name: binary_purchase_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can each restaurant be purchased at most once, or can the same restaurant be purchased multiple times?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about at-most-once purchase multiplicity, which is related to the all-or-nothing purchase decision, but it did not explicitly ask whether fractional/partial purchase of a restaurant is allowed.

slot_scores.name: conditional_exclusion_restaurant_D_and_A
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any dependency or restriction between purchasing Restaurant D and Restaurant A.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases are binary 0-1 decisions for whole restaurants, with no fractional ownership.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed at-most-once purchasing, not whether partial/fractional purchase is allowed, yet the READY_TO_MODEL summary explicitly states binary purchase variables.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There are no conditional exclusions or dependencies among restaurants, so all restaurant choices are independent.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about restrictions such as not being able to buy both A and D, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary treats the problem as a standard 0-1 knapsack with only a budget constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while H1 was only partially addressed and H2 was never asked, leaving P1 hidden slots unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several basic data and objective points but missed the conditional exclusion between Restaurants D and A and did not fully confirm the binary all-or-nothing purchase assumption before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
